brief: UXUI individual UT submission for Napaul, on the KMITL-BApp Figma file bhuuET1PKmzZSGMkVr2de7, responsible UI task screens S6-S10 (Select Date and Time, Booking Details Empty, Booking Details Filled, Upload Documents Empty, Upload Documents Uploaded, Review Booking, Booking Submitted). Then the eight graded deliverables: (1) brief profile of the five test participants, using pseudonyms; (2) summarise the feedback from each participant; (3) show all UI screens for the responsible task, including how the grid and pattern design were set; (4) capture every page with the grid setting visible, as a PDF; (5) a second PDF containing each page separately with no grid; (6) compare before and after of the UI improvements, framing or highlighting each improved point, where one page may carry more than one point; (7) a brief explanation of the reasons and details of each improvement; (8) submit the updated and finalised Figma link.
